summary: Festi hf. engages in the retail sale of fuel, goods, groceries and related products, and electronic equipment in Iceland. The company engages in the product storage, packaging, labelling, handling, and distribution of products; sale of household appliances and electronic equipment; leasing of non-residential real estate to retail companies; production of convenience goods; import and wholesale of alcohol to ATVR stores, hotels, and restaurants; operates convenience stores; pharmacy operations; wholesale and retail sales of health-related products; imports and wholesales of pharmacy products and cosmetic products; and wholesale and retail of fuel and and electricity. It also operates service stations, including tire and lubrication service stations, as well as online shops and mobile apps with home deliveries; food service and convenience goods; and security and development departments. The company was formerly known as N1 hf. and changed its name to Festi hf. in September 2018. Festi hf. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Kópavogur, Iceland.
